Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Yucaipa for 2026, and here is what he found: 3 family events, 2 of them free. The magic runs from November 28 (Winterfest and Tree Lighting) through December 12 (the Yucaipa Christmas Parade), with The Nutcracker at the Yucaipa Performing Arts Center (December 4 to 6) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Yucaipa
